config.tooltip-delay.desc: How long the cursor must rest on an element before its tooltip appears.
config.debug-overlay.desc: Draw the bounds and ids of every element in framework menus.
config.log-callbacks.desc: Write a trace log line every time a consumer callback is invoked.
config.inspector-hotkey.desc: Toggles the in-game inspector while a framework menu is open: hover elements to see their bounds, margins and properties, nudge them with the keyboard, and press E to export the menu as C# code.
